title: Improper order of operations in `cancelLock` expose funds to theft
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium   ## Description  Function `cancelLock()` does not follow the CEI pattern; it first makes the external call and then deletes the `locks[]` variable. If the execution reaches an attacker-controlled address during the external call, then it would be possible to perform the same operation multiple times and steal other users’ funds.  ```solidity         SafeERC20.forceApprove(targetToken, address(vault), lock.amount);         vault.deposit(lock.amount, lock.user);          emit LockCancelled(lockId);          delete locks[lockId]
